title: Bio & Education
text: Devkumar Banerjee is a Computer Science and Engineering student at Texas A&M University (TAMU). He builds high-performance web applications, machine learning tools, cybersecurity infrastructure, and interactive terminal interfaces. Contact: devkumar@tamu.edu | GitHub: aptitudepi | LinkedIn: dvkb

title: PCPG Analyzer (Cancer Research)
text: PCPG Analyzer is a web-based bio-analysis framework developed by Devkumar for dynamic analysis and visualization of Pheochromocytoma & Paraganglioma transcriptome data. Built with Python, Streamlit, and Pandas to assist cancer researchers worldwide.

title: TheAggieMap (HowdyHack 2025)
text: TheAggieMap is a full-stack monorepo featuring a Next.js 14 frontend and FastAPI backend serving as Texas A&M Aggieland interactive campus navigation map. Built for HowdyHack 2025 using TypeScript, Next.js, and Python.

title: Doctor-Robot (TIDALHack)
text: Doctor-Robot maps natural-language symptom descriptions to structured medical data and classifies into 40+ disease categories using an XGBoost classifier integrated with Groq-hosted LLMs. Built for TIDALHack with Streamlit and Groq.

title: Neural-Networks-From-Scratch
text: Neural-Networks-From-Scratch is a collection of neural network architectures built completely from scratch using only NumPy in Python, demonstrating fundamental deep learning concepts and backpropagation algorithms.

title: Cybersecurity & GIAC Certifications
text: Devkumar holds prestigious cybersecurity credentials including the GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC), GIAC Foundational Cybersecurity Technologies (GFACT), and an appointment to the GIAC Advisory Board. He also holds Cisco CCST Cybersecurity and CCST Networking certifications.

title: Cloud & AI Certifications
text: Cloud and AI credentials include Microsoft Certified Azure Fundamentals, Microsoft Certified Azure AI Fundamentals, Microsoft Certified Security Compliance and Identity Fundamentals, and GitHub Foundations.

title: Management & Professional Certifications
text: Professional credentials include PMI Project Management Ready, HubSpot Digital Marketing Certified, TestOut Linux Pro, and Master Certification in Entrepreneurship.

title: Website Architecture & Stack
text: dvxb.io is a terminal-themed portfolio built with xterm.js, Three.js particles, CRT scanlines, Anime.js, Motion animations, NumberFlow counters, live GitHub Heatmap/Radar, and in-browser AI with Groq & Transformers.js.
